offline_engine.notes: Deterministic offline cybersecurity engine only. The historical 0.13 ms was offline-engine regex-only matching.

ollama_qwen3_8b.recommendation: Host machine possesses 7.7 GB total physical RAM with ~1.0 GB unreserved headroom. Loading qwen3:8b (5.2 GB) causes severe swapping, OOM, or timeouts exceeding 30s. Recommend benchmarking or deploying qwen3:4b or qwen2.5:1.5b for edge deployments with <= 8 GB RAM.

ollama_qwen3_4b.notes: Attempting CPU inference on a machine with 7.7 GB physical RAM at 89% utilization causes llama-server context initialization timeout (>30s) or OOM. Auto-tier selection appropriately triggers warning and routes to offline engine or cloud provider.
